definition: Neurodevelopmental disorder with poor or absent speech, dysmorphic facies, and behavioral abnormalities (NEDSFB; OMIM #621182) is a rare genetic neurodevelopmental condition associated with variants in the NAV3 gene on chromosome 12q21, clinically characterized by developmental delay, intellectual disability, impaired or absent language development, facial dysmorphisms, microcephaly, and behavioral issues.
